registration.title: Clubs changing division moved towards their new division
registration.what: When a club is promoted or relegated, move its rank halfway to the average of the division it joins.
registration.why: Relegated clubs are overrated by 0.47 goals a match in their first five league matches, and promoted clubs underrated by about 0.15.
registration.how: One number (how far to move), applied on a club's first league match in a new division of the same country.
registration.hypothesis: Moving a club on arrival removes the error of its first twenty matches.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Selection window
events.meaningful: The figure the setting was chosen on.

events.label: Final period
events.meaningful: Real: the interval excludes zero and it held from development. A quarter of the bar.

events.reason: A real gain below the bar. Carried forward inside the combined candidate of protocol P14.
